thesis: After one target-point choice, VOID Auto-Edit automates object selection, lossless quadmask generation, VOID removal, and frame-level audit that previously required hours of human footage review.

workflow_effect.manual_baseline: A human reviews footage frame by frame, discovers ambiguous referents, corrects masks, reruns inpainting, and compares outputs by eye.
workflow_effect.automatic_path: Target point once; SAM referent identity, quadmask conversion, VOID execution, and measured failure gates run without per-frame hand correction.
workflow_effect.non_claim: The interface and target choice are human decisions. The claim is automation after target choice, not a fully autonomous editor.

non_claims: Referent locking is post hoc in the demonstrated candidate C correction.
Mean IoU 0.467366 narrowly misses the proposed 0.470294 bar; that bar is not in force.
The Muse rescue applies only to frames 16-23.
Metrics quantify masks, removal stability, and recovery, not artistic quality or production readiness.
No claim is made that a professional artist could not perform equivalent manual rotoscoping.
